[Intro]
[Dm]
[Am]
[C]
[Dm]

[Verse 1]
[Dm]Just like the songbird,
[Am]deep in the forest
[C]I sing praises but
you never [Dm]hear
And deep in my body
[Am]my song is silent
[C]Yet contented at
times when you're [Dm]near

[Verse 2]
[Dm]Please listen to me
[Am]and I will tell thee
[C]All those words that have
never been [Dm]said
They shout inside me
[Am]but then they cower
[C]Behind weakness that's
ruling my [Dm]head

[Solo]
[Dm]
[Am]
[C]
[Dm]
[Am]
[C]
[Dm]

[Verse 3]
[Dm]I dearly love thee
[Am]and not one other
[C]With a sweetness that
lies in my [Dm]breast
'Tis you that made me
[Am]but God forbade me
[C]To uncover my
heart to love's [Dm]test

[Verse 4]
[Dm]No love is sorrow
[Am]and now I'm happy
[C]To have thee in this
world for my [Dm]love
And now you must know
[Am]my soul is for thee
[C]That's why this life is
my soaring [Dm]dove

[Outro]
[C]That's why this life is
my soaring [Dm]dove
title: No Love is Sorrow
tuning: E A D G B E
